context:
Goal: no page item is lost if a page goes.
Problem (cannot undo): mailaudit's .claude/layout-extras.json names waiting page FBKSLCBLJsvfNGeePvDz13. This account gets "artifact not found" for it, and no copy was ever saved to mailaudit's roadmap branch, so its items can't be copied from here.
Based on (read): lane mailaudit-waiting-copy, Artifact read at 17:57 CST.
Departs from: main names a page no cloud session here can open — the repo gets a new page, or points at the page as the account that can open it holds it.
If a: open the link. If it opens, tell triage which account you used; a session on that account then saves a copy. If it doesn't open, mailaudit makes a new page.
Meanwhile: mailaudit's layout check stays red on main; nothing waits on it.
Link: https://claude.ai/artifact/FBKSLCBLJsvfNGeePvDz13

options.gain: No item is lost, if any exist.
options.label: I'll open the old page first
Make a new mailaudit page now
options.lose: Any items on the old page are lost.

short: mailaudit's old page: open it or replace it?
title: mailaudit points at a waiting page this account can't open. Check it, or replace it?
why: If that page holds items, they have no copy anywhere, so replacing it would lose them.
